campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from WashU Residential Life's official South 40 building directory. All first- and second-year students live on the South 40, and WashU names every building and describes its two housing patterns (modern buildings, where two double rooms are adjoined by a shared restroom, and traditional buildings, with single and double rooms on a corridor and common restrooms) plus the furnishings in every room. It publishes no per-room dimensions, so every room here uses the site's estimate fallback and is labelled "Estimated based on similar rooms. Official size not published." Beds are extra-long twin (36" x 80") on frames that sit 36 inches off the floor, which is worth measuring under before buying storage.
